approaches.title: In-place bottom-up dynamic programming
approaches.summary: Updates each triangle row in place using the minimum path sum from the preceding row, then returns the minimum value in the final row.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Initial in-place dynamic programming solution using boundary-safe indexing with sentinel values.
Keeps the same in-place dynamic programming strategy while replacing sentinel-based indexing with explicit boundary matching and refining the final-row return.
